Seal.Good.detail: Key and nonce sizes are in the types (Key32, Nonce24), so the contract has no size premise. The running suite cryptoSeal has it given the crypto trust file (engine/core/Trust.lean, Trust.Native: XChaCha20-Poly1305 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 open what they seal, X25519 agrees, SHA-256 digests are 32 bytes) (cryptoSeal_good); the bridge is exercised and the executable checks native roundtrips across 64-byte block boundaries. Conditional on the trust file, which finite roundtrips cannot prove.

openSealed_seal.detail: Applied at the running suite to a concrete 32-byte key and 24-byte nonce (sizes by construction) and a 46-byte text; the plaintext bound is a kernel proof, the associated-data bound is decided. Conditional only on the trust file; the executable opens the app's own sealedPost output through openStored. Mutation control: openSealed taking its nonce from the end fails the proof.

member_opens.detail: Applied at the running suite to concrete sized keys and nonce; conditional only on the trust file. Native wrap/unbox/open roundtrips pass. Mutation control: a key id that carries the key fails the proof.

unbox_box.detail: Applied at the running suite to concrete sized secrets and content key; conditional only on the trust file. Mutation controls: unbox reading the ephemeral key one byte late, and box leaving it out, fail the proof.

openBody_sealBody.detail: Applied through openSealed_seal at the running suite with sized key and nonce; conditional only on the trust file.

cryptoSeal_good.detail: The running suite is good given the crypto trust file (engine/core/Trust.lean, Trust.Native: XChaCha20-Poly1305 and ChaCha20-Poly1305 open what they seal, X25519 agrees, SHA-256 digests are 32 bytes). tests/vacuity/CryptoTrust.lean checks each part on the native crates and fails a broken model of each in the kernel. Mutation control: cryptoSeal opening under the zero nonce fails the proof.

sealedPost_opens.detail: The app's sealedPost, for a 32-byte community id, sized key and nonce and a 46-byte text: every premise is discharged but the trust file. The executable decodes the actual op and opens it through openStored to the text; another key, another community, a same-size tampered body and stored keys of 0/1/31/33/64 bytes open nothing. Mutation control: a post bound to another community fails the proof.

wrapKey_opens.detail: The app's wrapKey to a node key, opened by unbox with its secret: conditional only on the trust file. The executable unboxes the actual wrap op to the content key; another secret unboxes nothing. Mutation control: a wrap to the approver's own key fails the proof.

member_reads.detail: wrapKey, unbox, sealedPost and openStored together: conditional only on the trust file. The executable runs the whole path on the actual ops and recovers the text.
